items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: Ray Brown's playing drums... like Jay McShann’s playing piano, Ray Brown’s playing drums, Phil Woods playing alto, and Bob Wilber’s playing clarinet.

ctx.x: You know if a musician today wanted to get into that circuit, what do they have to — besides that they have to play good — but is there other things? I mean like there’s a standard repertory that you have. © Fillius Jazz Archive -15-

You just better know a lot of tunes from the ‘20s right up to the ‘50s, and you better be able to put your ego at the door and be able to fit in. I always looked at it as being a great character actor. You know if you’re an actor on a stage, you can’t go in there being the big star. But if you’re a great character actor and somebody says, “Okay, at two o’clock you’re going to be in this band,” like Jay McShann’s playing piano, Ray Brown’s playing drums, Phil Woods playing alto, and Bob Wilber’s playing clarinet.…
